title: Mapping over encoded words
statement: Let $g$ be any function from bit strings to bit strings, and let $q$ and $w$ be bit strings. Applying the map operation to the encoding of $(q,w)$ yields the concatenated encodings, with empty second component, of the words obtained by decoding $w$ and applying $g$ to the encoding of each decoded word.
hypotheses_covered: $g$ is a function from bit strings to bit strings
